local function update(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
end

Title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = MainFrame.Position
        
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

Title.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then

end)

local function getF3XTool()
    local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer

    for i,v in player:GetDescendants() do
        if v.Name == "SyncAPI" then
            tool = v.Parent
            break
        end
    end
    
    if not tool then
        for i,v in game.ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants() do
            if v.Name == "SyncAPI" then
                tool = v.Parent
                break
            end
        end
    end
    
    return tool

local function findPlayerByName(name)
    if not name or name == "" then return nil end
    -- try exact match first
    local p = Players:FindFirstChild(name)
    if p then return p end
    -- try case-insensitive match
    local lname = name:lower()
    for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if pl.Name:lower():find(lname, 1, true) or (pl.DisplayName and pl.DisplayName:lower():find(lname,1,true)) then
            return pl
        end
    end
    return nil
end

    -- Ensure our character exists and has HRP

-- HeadSit: continuously position your HRP on target's head (local-only)
local headSitting = false
local headTarget = nil
headsitBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local target = findPlayerByName(headsitText.Text)
    if not target then warn("Target for HeadSit not found.") return end
    if not target.Character or not target.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then warn("Target has no head.") return end
    headSitting = not headSitting
    headTarget = headSitting and target or nil
    headsitBtn.Text = headSitting and "Stop HeadSit" or "HeadSit (local)"
end)

-- Orbit visuals: create client-side decorative parts that orbit your HRP
local orbiting = false
local orbitParts = {}
orbitToggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    orbiting = not orbiting
    orbitToggleBtn.Text = orbiting and "Stop Orbit Visuals" or "Toggle Orbit Visuals Around Me"
    if orbiting then
        local count = math.clamp(tonumber(orbitCountBox.Text) or 5, 1, 20)
        -- create orbit parts (these are regular Parts parented to workspace; they may replicate in some environments)
        for i = 1, count do
            local p = Instance.new("Part")
            p.Size = Vector3.new(0.8,0.8,0.8)
            p.Anchored = true
            p.CanCollide = false
            p.BrickColor = BrickColor.Random()
            p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
            p.Name = "LocalOrbitPart_"..i
            p.Parent = workspace
            table.insert(orbitParts, p)
        end
    else
        for _, p in ipairs(orbitParts) do
            if p and p.Parent then p:Destroy() end
        end
        orbitParts = {}
    end
end)

-- Main render loop for spam teleport, headsit, and orbit
local t = 0
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    -- spam teleport behavior
    if spamTeleporting then
        local target = findPlayerByName(teleportText.Text)
        if target and target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            -- teleport frequently but with a small delay between teleports (we are inside RenderStepped so do every frame;
            -- to avoid extreme update rates, teleport only every ~0.08s using accumulator)
            -- We'll implement via simple time accumulator:
            if not script:FindFirstChild("__spamTimer") then
                local marker = Instance.new("NumberValue"); marker.Name = "__spamTimer"; marker.Parent = script
                marker.Value = 0
            end
            local marker = script:FindFirstChild("__spamTimer")
            marker.Value = marker.Value + dt
            if marker.Value >= 0.08 then
                marker.Value = 0
                local tgtHRP = target.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = tgtHRP.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0)
            end
        end
    end

    -- HeadSit local positioning
    if headSitting and headTarget and headTarget.Character and headTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") and char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        local head = headTarget.Character.Head
        -- place our HRP slightly above the head (visual sitting)
        local sitCFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0.6, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(180), 0)
        char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = sitCFrame
        -- Optionally set Humanoid.PlatformStand = true for better visual stability (local-only)
        local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid then
            humanoid.PlatformStand = true
        end
    else
        -- restore PlatformStand when not head-sitting
        local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if humanoid and humanoid.PlatformStand then
            humanoid.PlatformStand = false
        end
    end

    -- Orbit visuals update
    if orbiting and #orbitParts > 0 and char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        t = t + dt * 1.5
        local center = char.HumanoidRootPart.Position
        local n = #orbitParts
        local radius = 4
        for i, p in ipairs(orbitParts) do
            local angle = t + (i-1)*(2*math.pi/n)
            local offset = Vector3.new(math.cos(angle)*radius, 1.6, math.sin(angle)*radius)
            p.Position = center + offset
            p.CFrame = CFrame.new(p.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, angle, 0)
        end
    end
end)

-- Clean up created objects when player leaves or script is removed
player.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
    if not parent then
        for _, p in ipairs(orbitParts) do if p and p.Parent then p:Destroy() end end
        orbitParts = {}
    end
end)

            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

PanelTitle.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and input == dragInput then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        AdminPanel.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
end)

-- Login Butonu İşlevi
LoginButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    local username = UsernameBox.Text
    if username == "" then
        username = LocalPlayer.Name
    end
    
    -- Login animasyonu
    TweenService:Create(LoginFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.3), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)}):Play()
    wait(0.3)
    LoginFrame:Destroy()
    
    -- Admin panel göster
    UserDisplay.Text = "👤 Kullanıcı: " .. username
    AdminPanel.Visible = true
    ToggleButton.Visible = true
    AdminPanel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    TweenService:Create(AdminPanel, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 500)}):Play()
end)

-- Enter tuşu ile login
UsernameBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
    if enterPressed then
        LoginButton.MouseButton1Click:Fire()
    end
end)

-- Toggle Key (INSERT) - Sadece toggle butonu ile değiştirildi
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if not gameProcessed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Insert then
        if ToggleButton.Visible then
            ToggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Fire()
        end
    end
end)
